task_description: Build a complete bilingual (FR/EN) PWA for restaurant 'Place de la Victoire' in Kara, Togo — React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Storage, Hosting). Roles: admin, serveur, cuisine, client. QR-code table identification. Real-time order flow with animated countdown. Offline-partial via Vite PWA Plugin (Workbox).
